# Reason

> > Reason is a libertarian magazine and website covering politics, culture, and ideas from a free minds and free markets perspective.

Founded in 1968, Reason provides commentary and analysis on civil liberties, economic freedom, immigration, drug policy, and government overreach. The publication features work from prominent libertarian writers including Nick Gillespie, Katherine Mangu-Ward, Matt Welch, and founding editor Robert Poole.

## Key Topics

- Libertarianism
- Civil liberties
- Free speech
- Immigration policy
- Drug policy reform
- Privatization
- Property rights
- Gun rights
- Budget and fiscal policy
- Criminal justice reform
- Free markets
- Government regulation
- Individual freedom
- Constitutional rights
